propositions: Three 300-second wall-clock git fetch operations lack throughput-based abort and have identical stall exposure as the snapshot fetch fixed in 12e4
The stall_abort_args() and is_stall_abort() functions from git_fetch module must be reused across gerrit_client, workspace, and init fetch sites
Each of the three fetch sites must pass http.lowSpeedLimit and http.lowSpeedTime to abort zero-byte transfers while permitting dribbling (low but non-zero throughput) transfers
Tests must verify stall abort fires for zero-byte remotes and does not fire for low-throughput remotes at each of the three call sites
